name: Dripping Of The Insect Cage
source:
Kira Adams, as punishment for her night of debauchery is is sent to their aunt’s motel to manage for a few days, not so much because she’s qualified but because her father wants to keep her out of public view while the election is going on.

What starts out like a standard, boring, vacation quickly descends into something more sinister as unexplained incidents start happening.


One of the workers claim the place is haunted by ghosts of past guests... maybe there's more to that than meets the eye? Is the motel truly crawling with ghosts or is Kira just finally losing her mind?

[From [url=https://tea-and-torment.itch.io/drippings-of-the-insect-cage]itch.io[/url]]
